title: eurybia glauca
intro: Eurybia glauca, commonly known as Blue-eyed Grass, is a species of flowering plant in the family Asteraceae. It is traditionally used to treat various health issues, including coughs, colds, and respiratory problems, due to its expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Eurybia glauca are attributed to its anti-inflammatory and antispasmodic properties, which help to soothe and calm the respiratory system. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
